remarks: Welcome to your dream home in the sought-after Harborview Beach Association! This waterfront community has everything you need for a vibrant coastal lifestyle. Enjoy access to the private clubhouse, tennis courts, playground, ball field, moorings, and docks-perfect for boaters and outdoor enthusiasts alike. The spacious four-bedroom, three-bath home features a charming front porch, perfect for morning coffee or evening sunsets, and a fenced-in backyard ideal for privacy and play. Don't miss your chance to live in this charming neighborhood just steps from the water! Rental duration is flexible: Monthly or yearly available. HOA of $2,000 is tenant responsibility for yearly rentals
